toegepas.voor: Die kinders het vir hom gewaai en hy het
toegepas.na: Die kinders het vir hom gewaai, en hy het
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: comma before en when it joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two full clauses (die kinders het gewaai / hy het gehardloop), so the AWS 2017 comma is required.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'daar oor was' reads stiffly; 'oorgebly het' is the natural expression with the same meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'wat nog daar oor was' reads stiff and wooden.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'wat nog oorgebly het' is the natural expression and says the same thing.

toegepas.voor: op die warm sement gelê en daar was
toegepas.na: op die warm sement gelê, en daar was
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: comma before en joining two full clauses (sy bak het gelê / daar was).
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Sy bak het gelê / daar was geen water are two clauses, each with its own subject and verb.

toegepas.voor: Ons ken hom nie en hy ken ons
toegepas.na: Ons ken hom nie, en hy ken ons
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: comma before en joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Ons ken hom nie / hy ken ons ook nie are two clauses; the comma does not disturb the dialogue's rhythm.

toegepas.voor: Hy wou nie hê dat oom Koos in die moeilikheid kom nie.
toegepas.na: Hy wou nie hê oom Koos moet in die moeilikheid kom nie.
toegepas.rede_vinder: After 'wou nie hê' Afrikaans naturally uses 'moet' without 'dat'; the bare present 'kom' sits awkwardly in a past narrative.
toegepas.fout: 'dat ... kom' with a bare present sits stiffly in a past narrative.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Hy wou nie hê oom Koos moet in die moeilikheid kom nie' is the natural Afrikaans construction with the same meaning.

toegepas.na: wat die twee kinders vertel het
toegepas.rede_vinder: The telling happened before the listening in a past narrative, so the past tense 'vertel het' is needed; the protected word vertel is kept.
toegepas.fout: Bare present 'vertel' in a past-tense narrative for an action already done.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'vertel het' fixes the tense and keeps the protected word 'vertel' intact.

toegepas.voor: 'n Veearts kyk hom dadelik van kop tot stert na wanneer ons aankom.
toegepas.na: 'n Veearts kyk hom van kop tot stert na sodra ons daar aankom.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'dadelik ... wanneer' is clumsy with the separable verb split far apart; 'sodra' carries the same immediacy more smoothly.
toegepas.fout: 'dadelik ... wanneer' is clumsy, with the immediacy word split far from its clause.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'sodra' carries the same immediacy smoothly, and 'daar' only points to the shelter already named, adding no new fact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The separable verb tuiskom is written as one word in the past participle: tuisgekom.
toegepas.fout: Separable verb 'tuiskom' written apart in the past participle.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The word list writes 'tuisgekom' as one word.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The compound verb stillê is written as one word, so the past participle is stilgelê.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Written apart, 'stil gelê' means the street lay quiet in the heat; 'stilgelê' leans to 'came to a standstill', so the meaning narrows.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The adverb reads more naturally after the object: 'die leiband kalm om die hond se nek gesit'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Moving 'kalm' is a lateral move; the original already reads naturally in the story.
